thread:
jess (support_engineer): Customer (AcmePay) reports repeated parse errors when using streaming JSON: "SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input". Happens only for stream=true. Non-stream works.

ryan (customer_success): They said it started after a proxy config change this week.

jess (support_engineer): Repro steps I ran with Node SDK:
```
const stream = client.responses.stream({model:'gpt-xyz',input:prompt,stream:true});
stream.on('data', c => console.log(c.toString()));
```
curl --no-buffer returns full JSON, SDK stops with socket EOF ~5s. Last bytes missing final "]}".

kate (devex): Can you paste the last raw bytes (hex) from their capture?

jess (support_engineer): Hex dump from customer tcpdump:
```
... 5c 6e 22 7d 0d 0a 0d 0a
# expected: 5d 7d 0a
```

mike (eng-runtime): Proxy finishing a connection with a FIN on idle is a known pattern. Which proxy?

ryan (customer_success): They use ProxyCorp forward-proxy v2.3, idle-timeout=5s, request-buffering=on.

olivia (eng-sre): Two asks: full X-Request-Id for failing calls and proxy logs + tcpdump aligned timestamps.

jess (support_engineer): Example X-Request-Id: rq_02HLY0B5. Server logs show final write flushed, then client side FIN shortly after:
[runtime] 2026-02-18T11:12:03Z write: 1100 bytes chunk seq=56
[runtime] 2026-02-18T11:12:03Z flush: buffer empty
[network] 2026-02-18T11:12:08Z conn: FIN from client

mike (eng-runtime): We're currently treating connection close as the authoritative EOF for structured streams. If upstream path sends FIN before client reads final bytes, final sentinel may be lost. Proposal: include explicit end sentinel chunk {"_redwood_stream_end":true} as last chunk and ensure it's retried via control channel. Also consider emitting zero-length chunk + CRLF to satisfy proxies using chunked encoding.

kate (devex): Adding sentinel is backward-incompatible for some SDKs. Alternative: SDKs should detect incomplete JSON and automatically fetch a non-streamed completion with same request id to recover final bytes. Also document known proxy configs.

olivia (eng-sre): Short-term mitigations for customer: increase proxy idle timeout to >30s, disable request buffering, or enable TCP keepalive on client (sub-1s probes). Non-streaming call is immediate workaround.

jess (support_engineer): Customer will test increasing idle timeout and share proxy logs + tcpdump tomorrow. They asked if SDK could do a resume/retry on parse error.

mike (eng-runtime): Action items:
- RFC to add explicit end-sentinel + server retransmit fallback (eng-runtime)
- SDK change: on parse failure, auto-fetch final payload via non-stream endpoint (devex + SDK teams)
- KB entry listing proxies with aggressive buffering and recommended config (devex)

jess (support_engineer): Filed ticket INC-2026-4510. Assigned eng-runtime. P2. I'll update customer once we have a timeline.

acme_infra_bot: Acme sysadmin note: We'll try increasing idle timeout tonight and report results.

kate (devex): I'll draft KB and include tunables: proxy idle, request_buffering=false, tcp_keepalive, and example nginx/ProxyCorp snippets.

mike (eng-runtime): Also consider server-side fallback: if final ack not observed within window, push final JSON via a short polling endpoint so SDKs can recover.

jess (support_engineer): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll follow up when customer provides logs.
